verdict.rationale: Codegen documents org-level agent permission settings that gate specific agent actions, such as whether it can create pull requests, plus a behavior setting where agents present a structured plan of each step. These are per-capability toggles rather than tiered autonomy levels, and nothing documents the agent waiting for manual confirmation before acting. Missing for 10: graduated autonomy tiers, explicit approve-before-execute confirmation gates, per-action confirmation policies, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can set tiered autonomy levels controlling what an agent can do without manual confirmation

citations.quote: Control whether the codegen agent is able to create pull requests in your repositories in response to user requests.
Agents will present a structured plan showing each implementation step
Agent only responds to comments containing explicit mentions
